scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @mgwaios/api && npm run build -w @mgwaios/worker && npm run build -w @mgwaios/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @mgwaios/shared && npm run build -w @mgwaios/core && npm run build -w @mgwaios/agents && npm run build -w @mgwaios/connectors && npm run build -w @mgwaios/db
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run check:apps
scripts.check:apps: npm run check -w @mgwaios/api && npm run check -w @mgwaios/worker && npm run check -w @mgwaios/web
